clips.title: The story
paras: At the dig northwest of Bloodhoof Village, dwarven picks lie broken on the forge. Baine Bloodhoof wants proof that the excavation threatening Mulgore's land and wildlife has been stopped.

Northwest of Bloodhoof Village, dwarven excavators dig into Mulgore's hills in search of ancient history. The tauren see their work as a defilement of the Earth Mother. The digging's noise and destruction agitate the local wildlife, especially the roaming kodo herds. Young Baine Bloodhoof orders defenders to take the prospectors' iron picks and break them at a forge. With their picks ruined, the expedition cannot gouge further into the earth.
